csv_project_name: AE for Hawaii Civil Engineering Projects
csv_agency: Naval Facilities Engineer Command NAVFAC Pacific
csv_scope_of_work: The A-E services will be for design and engineering services for projects at various locations under the cognizance of NAVFAC Hawaii. The A-E services are Civil Engineering (NAICS 541330) in nature, but may involve multidisciplines. Civil Projects: Design and engineering for new construction, alterations, repair of roadways/parking pavements; airfields; water treatment, pump stations, and/or distribution systems; sewage collection, pump stations, and/or treatment systems; drainage systems including erosion control and/or slope stabilization.
